CustomField.description: When this traveller submitted their feedback, stamped by GxFeedbackService as it saves their response. It is what stops a second answer from the same link and what keeps a reminder from reaching someone who has already answered. The booking's Feedback_Received_On__c still records the first answer for the trip.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When this traveller answered the feedback survey. Set automatically.
CustomField.label: Feedback Answered On
